in_hebrew.name: Basso
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Basso הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Italian word 'basso', meaning 'deep' or 'low'. In musical terms, it refers to the lowest part in a musical composition. Symbolically, Basso can represent a strong foundation or a deep sense of spiritual grounding.
